title: Harness Evaluation Case
description: A harness verdict with optional task outcome, latency, tool-use, and user-intervention observations.

entry.description: Executable-case entry point consumed by harness-gate-eval.cjs (e.g. bash-safety, verification-gate-pre, verification-verdict, toolchain-classify, evidence-status, file-protection, frustration-context). Cases without entry are static verdict records.

input.description: Entry-specific input: a real hook payload, run result, or evidence entries.

setup.description: Payloads replayed through the same entry before the case input (e.g. mark a pending edit).

provenance.description: Where this case came from: a real incident, runtime event, or locked regression. Required by corpus discipline (D8.4) — no imagined cases.

varianceKey.description: Marks a key case for the N-run consistency (variance) measurement.
